<script>
(function () {
  var css = [
    '.grid{',
    '  display:grid !important;',
    '  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr)) !important;',
    '  gap:28px !important;',
    '  align-items:stretch !important;',
    '}',
    '.grid > .card{',
    '  width:auto !important;',
    '  max-width:none !important;',
    '  margin:0 !important;',
    '}'
  ].join('\n');

  function inject() {
    if (document.getElementById('nifty-blog-grid-fix')) return;
    var s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'nifty-blog-grid-fix';
    s.textContent = css;
    (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
  }

  inject();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', inject);
  window.addEventListener('load', inject);
})();
</script>
footer:
<script>
(function () {
  // GA4: Phone call tracking - fires website_calls (existing key event) on all tel: links
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var link = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href^="tel:"]') : null;
    if (link && typeof gtag === 'function') {
      gtag('event', 'website_calls', {
        phone_number: decodeURIComponent((link.getAttribute('href') || '').replace('tel:', '')).trim(),
        page_location: window.location.href
      });
    }
  });
})();
</script>
